articles.summary: CINCINNATI --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 1, 2026-- American Financial Group, Inc. (NYSE: AFG) announced that it has declared a regular dividend of $0.97 per share of American Financial Group Common Stock. The dividend is payable on October 23, 2026, to holders of record on October 15, 2026.
articles.title: American Financial Group, Inc. Declares Quarterly Dividend
